🔥 straps | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and simplifying the testing of cloud-native applications, Docker containers, Kubernetes deployments, and general system administration tasks using Bash scripts and the Bats testing framework.
✨ Key Features: • Data Type Validation (integers, floats, strings, unsigned integers) • String Operations (starts with, ends with, contains)
📖 Summary: Straps is a comprehensive Bash testing harness that provides over 80 utility functions designed to streamline testing for cloud-native development, Docker containers, Kubernetes, system administration, and DevOps automation. It integrates seamlessly with the Bats testing framework, offering robust validation for data types, network operations, file systems, and cloud infrastructure components.
